# Board 4: Collective — motion and timing, generated

*Generated by `motion.cjs` from `docs/pins2/kit/`'s stylesheets and components. 535 motion declarations in 10 sheets · 51 timers in the components · the pop-up timing table. The value files cannot show any of this: they force a state and read it, never the time between two. `motion.md` beside this lists the @keyframes.*

## The pop-up timing sets — `b3/poptime.js` (the one place to retune)

His spec, 2026-09-30 18:13 EDT, retuned 18:29 and 19:23 EDT. **1** a hover pop-up that informs (the problem and all-pass cards, Stage deletion) · **2** any other hover pop-up (the image mark, hints, Export's peek) · **3** a pop-up a button opens (the date, repeat and start-date pickers). Waits are the mouse's only; the arc morphs in every set; only set 1's body grows. The CSS reads each as `--pop<set>-<name>`, set on `:root` by `poptime.js` at load — **a port must carry that file or the variables resolve to their fallbacks.**

| Set | openWait | fadeIn | grow | arc | closeWait | fadeOut | shrink | removed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 120ms | 140ms | 600ms | 600ms | 160ms | 180ms | 220ms | 260ms |
| 2 | 120ms | 220ms | — | 600ms | 160ms | 180ms | — | 240ms |
| 3 | — | 200ms | — | 600ms | — | 180ms | — | 220ms |
